 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Colloquiel"** is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is "Colloquial" which means used in ordinary or familiar conversation; not formal or literary. (बोलचाल की भाषा)
 
 
• **Example: **She used colloquial expressions in her speech that made it relatable to the audience.
 
 
 
• **"Colloquial"** refers to language used in informal communication, typically in conversation. (बोलचाल की भाषा)
 
 
• **Example: **His colloquial style of writing made the book easy to read and engaging.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Posthumous** (मरणोपरांत): Occurring, awarded, or appearing after the death of the originator.
 
 
• **Example:** The author received a posthumous award for his literary work.
 
 
 
• **Extraneous** (बाहरी): Irrelevant or unrelated to the subject being dealt with.
 
 
• **Example: **The report contained a lot of extraneous information that was not needed.
 
 
 
• **Quiescent** (शांत): In a state or period of inactivity or dormancy.
 
 
• **Example:** The volcano has been quiescent for years, showing no signs of eruption.
